events.name: San Francisco Giants at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Six relievers combined on a two-hitter to lift the Pittsburgh Pirates to a 5-2 win over the San Francisco Giants on Thursday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pirates use six relievers to two-hit the Giants in a 5-2 victory

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Brett Bateman had three hits, Nathan Lukes lined a two-run double with the bases loaded in the fifth inning and the Toronto Blue Jays moved within striking distance of the third AL wild-card spot with a 6-3 victory over the Cleveland Guardians on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Blue Jays beat Guardians 6-3 to close within a half-game of the final AL wild-card spot

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Jose Altuve hit a two-run homer and Daulton Varsho drove in two runs with a triple to lead the Houston Astros to a 6-2 victory over the Chicago White Sox on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Astros beat the White Sox 6-2 as Jose Altuve homers and Daulton Varsho triples

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Adley Rutschman homered twice in his return to Baltimore, and the Boston Red Sox rallied to beat the Orioles 6-5 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rutschman homers twice in return to Baltimore, and the Red Sox rally for a 6-5 victory

headlines.description: — Pete Crow-Armstrong hit his 39th homer, Kevin Gausman threw seven sharp innings and the Chicago Cubs beat the Milwaukee Brewers 2-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crow-Armstrong hits 39th homer to back Gausman in the Cubs' 2-1 win over the Brewers

events.name: Miami Marlins at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Carter Jensen finished a single shy of hitting for the cycle with a home run, triple and a double while driving in three runs and scoring three times as the Kansas City Royals defeated the Miami Marlins 7-3 on Thursday night to avoid a three-game...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jensen finishes a single shy of the cycle to help Royals win 7-3 and avoid sweep against Marlins

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Cal Quantrill allowed two singles and two walks in seven innings, and Corey Seager hit a two-run homer as the Texas Rangers beat the Tampa Bay Rays 6-0 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cal Quantrill continues strong run, Corey Seager homers as Rangers blank Rays 6-0

headlines.description: — Lawrence Butler drove in the go-ahead run with two-run single in the top of the fifth, and Athletics pitchers combined for 18 strikeouts in a 7-4 victory over the Seattle Mariners on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Butler drives in go-ahead run, A's pitchers combine for 18 strikeouts in 7-4 win over Mariners

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Teoscar Hernández hit a go-ahead, two-run double in the ninth inning off Riley O'Brien, lifting the Los Angeles Dodgers over the St. Louis Cardinals 3-2 on Thursday night to avoid a sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Teoscar Hernández delivers a dramatic 9th-inning walk-off double as Dodgers top Cardinals
